source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

parts.target: A **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit of yours and up to 3 **WAR DOG** units of yours up to 6" from it.
parts.effect: Whenever a **WAR DOG** unit picked this way makes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**, models in it can pass over models and terrain features, for the rest of the phase. While doing so, they can cross the [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of those models but must end the move outside it, and they pass any [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape) automatically.

data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as it begins.

**Target:** A **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit of yours and up to 3 **WAR DOG** units of yours up to 6" from it.

**Effect:** Whenever a **WAR DOG** unit picked this way makes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**, models in it can pass over models and terrain features, for the rest of the phase. While doing so, they can cross the [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of those models but must end the move outside it, and they pass any [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape) automatically.
